mapper.insert: insert into mall_refund_request(order_id, member_id, reason, images, status, create_time) values(#{orderId}, #{memberId}, #{reason}, #{images}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select r.*, o.order_no, o.total_amount, m.nick_name as member_nick from mall_refund_request r left join mall_order o on o.order_id = r.order_id left join mall_member m on m.member_id = r.member_id where r.request_id = #{requestId}
select * from mall_refund_request where order_id = #{orderId} order by create_time desc, request_id desc limit 1
